reason: 55 CZK for one can is about double what I pay per can for Monster or Big Shock on offer, and YEAHRBA mate is cheaper on Rohlik anyway. Every brand says natural now, so that alone doesn't justify the price for me.
objection: The price per can. I buy multipacks on discount, and a single 55 CZK can from an e-shop with delivery is the opposite of how I shop.
would_change_my_mind: Seeing it on Rohlik in a multipack on offer at around 30 CZK a can.
